content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: overtime on both queues plus chat deflection, no break delays. Predicted 79.1% service level for 11:30-13:30, just short of the 80% target, at ₹16,800.","why":"Payments calls are taking much longer than planned (handle time up to 479 s against a 313 s forecast), most likely because of a slow internal tool. IT has not confirmed this, so please check with them. Call volume and staffing look normal, so the fix is extra capacity and fewer calls. No plan reaches 80% in the disruption window, and R1 comes closest at 79.1%. It offers overtime to 35 payments agents (12:00-14:00) and 10 more (14:00-15:00), plus 5 general agents (12:00-14:00). It also moves 20% of simple enquiries on both queues to chat. Breaks stay as scheduled. Payments is predicted at 70.8% and general at 90.6%, with abandons at 6.4% against 18.0% if we do nothing. Rest of day is predicted at 90.9%.","trade_offs":["R1 costs ₹816 more than P4 (₹15,984), which reaches 77.4%. P4 is better for payments (74.0% vs 70.8%) and abandons slightly less (5.9% vs 6.4%), but it delays breaks and general falls to 81.9%.","R2 costs the same ₹16,800 but is worse on every measure: 77.3% overall, payments 69.5%.","P3 saves about ₹3,500 (₹13,320) but only reaches 70.8%, with 8.1% abandons.","The no-cost and low-cost options (P1 and P2, ₹0 to ₹1,224) leave the window at 40-46% with around 15-18% abandons. P1 even pushes payments down to 21.4%."],"watch":"Payments remains the weak queue at 70.8% under R1. Watch overtime uptake: if fewer than about 35 payments agents accept, service will fall short. Follow up with IT on the suspected slow tool. If it is fixed, handle times should drop and some of the overtime could be released."}
